summary: Chapter 14 of the be3_ai pipeline documentation. Covers the Parameter Extractor — the hybrid deterministic+AI stage that fills intent parameters. Documents the full execution order: entity ingestion, transformer attribute hint collection and 4-step sanitization, safe token stripping, PIE (Product Intelligence Extractor) for product_name/products/product_segments, Intel Shield for deduplication, attribute key canonicalization, AI fallback prompt, and the final merge with priority rules.
